title: Menu option numbers shift every turn (e.g. after an enemy dies or an item is consumed), so a number chosen based on the previous screen can silently map to a different action if not re-read carefully (I once meant to attack but hit 'use dried herbs' because the list had shrunk).
where: Barrow Crypt combat, and generally any combat/interaction with a dynamic menu
